What is this space?: Hello Maker Studio is one of three Makerspaces on campus. A Makerspace is a space where you can make things. More specifically, you can learn to 3D print, laser cut, sew, craft, and more.
Where are the other MakerSpaces?: The other Makerspaces are Texas Invention Works, known as TIW, and the Foundary. TIW is located in the EER and the Foundary is located in the Fine Arts Library.
How do I get trained?: Scan one of the QR codes on the wall and fill out the Qualtrics survey. Many questions are optional. Once you finish it, you will be sent an invite to enroll in the canvas course. Our training procedure is located there.
Is this free?: If you are making a personal project, yes, almost everything is free. If you are making a project for a faculty member or PI, they need to pay for materials.
